title: Query-log delivery stops for good once learn writes a gap entry citing kb/public/_gaps.md, which check.py refuses, so no usage or work sidecar reaches main and cost reads no figure
goal: Found in the SP-lyfnpu37 review: the automatic commit 'query log apply 20261010T064624Z-4efaf809' in _cache/querylog/worktree adds _gaps.md entries made from logged prompts that were backlog goals or research-queue briefs (F-44cf8da28cdf, F-7850c16a27a2), one citing kb/public/_gaps.md:1058; check.py refuses it ('cites kb/public/_gaps.md:1058, a file that is not in root public') and doc2query stale fails, so every apply --push since 2026-10-10 06:52Z exits 1 (72 'sync exit 1' lines in distill.log), the committed store's newest run stays 2026-10-08, and backlog.py cost reads 'no item line' for every item of the sprint. A gap entry apply writes passes check.py, a prompt that is a backlog goal or worker brief files no kb gap, and a delivery that fails its gate says so where the orchestrator reads it (selfcheck or land).
repro_reason: the stuck commit lives in the local query-log worktree; the committed store missing every run of 2026-10-10 shows its effect
notes: SP-lyfnpu37 close: every landing of the sprint warned 'landed with no work rows', and cost --rework SP read 'no item line' at the review and again at the close, because no delivery reached origin/main after 2026-10-10 06:52Z. SP-dqkf3i42 review (2026-10-10): cost --rework read 0 runs for every story while worker sessions of hours before still counted as open; the review's distill on a spool copy wrote no usage or work sidecar (only open sessions were left in the spool). Recurrence 2026-10-10, SP-yzs3bj6f: every landing warned that the worker's work sidecar was undelivered (querylog.py apply --push not run), and backlog.py cost --rework gave no figure for the sprint or any item at review or close, the third sprint in a row. Recurrence SP-m3azo2y7 (2026-10-10): every land warned that work sidecars were undelivered or late; cost --rework read no worker figures at review or close.
